skill.procedure:
def apply(inputs, premises):
    lengths = inputs["bag_lengths"]
    widths = inputs["bag_widths"]
    heights = inputs["bag_heights"]
    weights = inputs["bag_weights"]
    carry_limits = premises["carryon_max_dimensions"]
    carry_index = -1
    for i in range(len(lengths)):
        if carry_index == -1 and lengths[i] <= carry_limits[0] and widths[i] <= carry_limits[1] and heights[i] <= carry_limits[2]:
            carry_index = i
    base_fees = premises["base_checked_fees"]
    standard_weight = premises["standard_weight"]
    weight_bounds = premises["weight_upper_bounds"]
    weight_fees = premises["weight_fees"]
    standard_size = premises["standard_size"]
    size_bounds = premises["size_upper_bounds"]
    size_fees = premises["size_fees"]
    checked_ordinal = 0
    total_fees = 0
    for i in range(len(lengths)):
        if i != carry_index:
            fee_position = min(checked_ordinal, len(base_fees) - 1)
            base_fee = base_fees[fee_position]
            weight_fee = 0
            for j in range(len(weight_bounds)):
                if weights[i] > standard_weight and weights[i] <= weight_bounds[j]:
                    weight_fee = weight_fees[j]
            total_size = lengths[i] + widths[i] + heights[i]
            size_fee = 0
            for j in range(len(size_bounds)):
                if total_size > standard_size and total_size <= size_bounds[j]:
                    size_fee = size_fees[j]
            total_fees = total_fees + base_fee + max(weight_fee, size_fee)
            checked_ordinal = checked_ordinal + 1
    return {"answer": int(inputs["ticket_price"] + total_fees)}
